description: User story under REQ-194 for FBS-227. The pin moves to rcf-schemas 0.9.0 with every probe carrying an assertion; a criterion carrying supersededBy is retired in rcf audit coverage, rcf audit eval coverage and deterministic verify, with the successor-missing, self-supersession and cycle shapes failing strict coverage; and deterministic verify tests expectBody.matches against two fixed canaries before the body, so a match-anything pattern never passes a criterion.
asA: a chain author or verifier hand working on a product built with rcf-lite
iWant: rcf-lite on rcf-schemas 0.9.0 to retire superseded criteria cleanly and to refuse probes that assert nothing
soThat: coverage and verify count only live criteria and only probes that actually check the response

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given packages/rcf-lite/package.json reading "@stravica-ai/rcf-schemas": "0.9.0" and that version installed, when node bin/rcf.js define validate runs over this repository's own chain from packages/rcf-lite, then it exits 0 and prints no "[error]" line, and node bin/rcf.js audit coverage --strict over the same chain exits 0.

[failure] Given a fixture chain at rcf-schemas 0.9.0 whose US-101 holds AC-101-1 with no probe, when rcf define update US-101 --ac AC-101-1 --probe '{"path":"/"}' runs (a probe with path only, carrying none of expectStatus, expectHeader, expectBody or selector), then it exits 3, stderr carries a line naming AC-101-1 and "missing assertion" and listing the four assertion fields, and rcf/user-stories/us-101.json is byte-identical to its state before the command.

[must-not] Given the pin at rcf-schemas 0.9.0, a fixture chain whose FBS-001 scopes AC-101-1 and AC-101-2, an rcf/verify-catalog.json at catalogVersion 1 whose AC-101-1 entry is { "path": "/" } and whose AC-101-2 entry is { "path": "/", "expectStatus": 200 }, and a local server answering GET / with 200, when rcf verify run --url <server> --fbs FBS-001 --mode deterministic runs, then it exits 4, the report records AC-101-1 with result "fail" and evidence.failedExpectation "missing assertion" (never the name of a single assertion field such as "expectStatus", which the 0.9.0 acProbe subschema error would otherwise name first), never "pass", runStats.counts.failed counts it and runStats.counts.verified counts AC-101-2 only; and rcf define validate on that chain exits 3 naming the key AC-101-1.

[must-not] Given the pin at rcf-schemas 0.9.0 and a fixture chain whose rcf/user-stories/us-101.json already carries an AC-level probe { "path": "/" } on AC-101-1 (written to disk, not through the CLI), when rcf define validate runs, then it exits 3 naming AC-101-1 and its probe; and when rcf verify run --url <server> --fbs FBS-001 --mode deterministic runs on that tree, the report records AC-101-1 with result "fail" and evidence.failedExpectation "missing assertion", never "pass", and the command exits 4.

[happy] Given a fixture project initialised by initProject (the test/cli/coverage.test.js world) whose REQ-001 holds US-101 with acceptance criteria AC-101-1 and AC-101-2 and the pin at rcf-schemas 0.9.0, where AC-101-1 carries supersededBy AC-101-2, supersededOn 2026-10-20 and supersessionNote "replaced by AC-101-2" and has no test case, and AC-101-2 is bound by a test case whose testPointer resolves, when rcf audit coverage runs (strict by default), then it exits 0, REQ-001 reads covered, the AC-101-1 row reads "retired (AC-101-2)" in the AC covered column, --format json gives AC-101-1 state "retired", supersededBy "AC-101-2" and covered false with totals.retiredAcs 1, --format mermaid carries the edge "AC-101-1 -. supersededBy .-> AC-101-2", and --mode shallow-any prints the same retired row and exits 0.

[failure] Given a fixture project initialised by initProject (the test/cli/coverage.test.js world) whose REQ-001 holds US-101 with acceptance criteria AC-101-1 and AC-101-2 and the pin at rcf-schemas 0.9.0, where AC-101-1 carries supersededBy AC-101-9 (with supersededOn and supersessionNote) and no AC-101-9 exists in the chain, when rcf audit coverage runs, then it exits 4 and stdout carries the line "supersession: AC-101-1 supersededBy AC-101-9: successor not found in the chain"; with --mode shallow-any it prints the same line and exits 0; rcf define validate on the same chain exits 0.

[failure] Given a fixture project initialised by initProject (the test/cli/coverage.test.js world) whose REQ-001 holds US-101 with acceptance criteria AC-101-1 and AC-101-2 and the pin at rcf-schemas 0.9.0, where AC-101-1 carries supersededBy AC-101-1 (with supersededOn and supersessionNote), when rcf audit coverage runs, then it exits 4 and stdout carries the line "supersession: AC-101-1 supersededBy AC-101-1: a criterion cannot supersede itself"; with --mode shallow-any it prints the same line and exits 0; rcf define validate on the same chain exits 0.

[failure] Given a fixture project initialised by initProject (the test/cli/coverage.test.js world) whose REQ-001 holds US-101 with acceptance criteria AC-101-1 and AC-101-2 and the pin at rcf-schemas 0.9.0, where AC-101-1 carries supersededBy AC-101-2 and AC-101-2 carries supersededBy AC-101-1 (each with supersededOn and supersessionNote), when rcf audit coverage runs, then it exits 4 and stdout carries exactly one line for the cycle, "supersession: AC-101-1 supersededBy AC-101-2: cycle AC-101-1 -> AC-101-2 -> AC-101-1", starting at the lowest id in the cycle; with --mode shallow-any it prints the same line and exits 0; rcf define validate on the same chain exits 0.

[edge] Given a fixture project initialised by initProject (the test/cli/coverage.test.js world) whose REQ-001 holds US-101 with acceptance criteria AC-101-1 and AC-101-2 and the pin at rcf-schemas 0.9.0, where AC-101-1 carries supersededBy AC-101-2, supersededOn 2026-10-20 and supersessionNote "replaced by AC-101-2" and is still bound by a test case TC-1 whose testPointer resolves, and AC-101-2 has no test case, when rcf audit coverage runs, then it exits 4 with REQ-001 uncovered, the AC-101-1 row reads "retired (AC-101-2)" and still lists TC-1 in its Test cases column, --format json lists TC-1 under AC-101-1 testCases with state "retired", and TC-1 is not counted toward REQ-001 or toward AC-101-2.

[must-not] Given a fixture project initialised by initProject (the test/cli/coverage.test.js world) whose REQ-001 holds US-101 with acceptance criteria AC-101-1 and AC-101-2 and the pin at rcf-schemas 0.9.0 and a third criterion AC-101-3, where AC-101-1 carries supersededBy AC-101-2, supersededOn 2026-10-20 and supersessionNote "replaced by AC-101-2" and has no test case, AC-101-2 is bound by a resolving test case and AC-101-3 has no resolving test case, when rcf audit coverage runs, then it exits 4, REQ-001 reads uncovered and the AC-101-3 row reads "no"; AC-101-1 never reads "yes" in the AC covered column nor covered true in --format json, in strict or shallow-any mode, and totals.covered never counts a requirement on the strength of a retired criterion.

[edge] Given a fixture tree where AC-101-1 is nonDeterministic, carries supersededBy AC-101-2, supersededOn 2026-10-20 and supersessionNote "replaced by AC-101-2" and has no EVAL bound, and AC-101-2 is nonDeterministic with a resolving EVAL, when rcf audit eval coverage --strict runs, then it exits 0, AC-101-1 reads outcome "retired" with supersededBy "AC-101-2" (never "missing") and missingCount is 0; with a third nonDeterministic criterion AC-101-3 that has no EVAL, the same command reads AC-101-3 "missing" and exits 4.

[must-not] Given the pin at rcf-schemas 0.9.0, a fixture chain whose FBS-001 scopes AC-101-1 and AC-101-2, where AC-101-1 carries supersededBy AC-101-2, supersededOn 2026-10-20 and supersessionNote "replaced by AC-101-2" and an AC-level probe { "path": "/retired", "expectStatus": 200 }, and AC-101-2 carries { "path": "/", "expectStatus": 200 }, and a local server that records every path it is asked for, when rcf verify run --url <server> --fbs FBS-001 --mode deterministic runs, then the server never receives a request for /retired, the report records AC-101-1 with result "retired" and evidence.supersededBy "AC-101-2", never "pass" or "fail", runStats.counts.verified and runStats.counts.failed never count AC-101-1, and with AC-101-2 passing the command exits 0.

[happy] Given a fixture chain whose FBS-001 scopes the US-101 criteria (the test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js world), a local HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 answering GET / with status 200 and body "

Notes

Hello, world 0123abcd" and content-type "text/html", when rcf verify run --url --fbs FBS-001 --mode deterministic runs with AC-101-1 carrying expectBody.matches set in turn to "

\s*Notes\s*

", "Hello, \w+" and "[0-9a-f]{8}", each matching the body, then each run exits 0, AC-101-1 has result "pass" and runStats.counts.verified is 1.

[failure] Given a fixture chain whose FBS-001 scopes the US-101 criteria (the test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js world), a local HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 answering GET / with status 200 and body "

Notes

Hello, world 0123abcd" and content-type "text/html", when rcf verify run --url --fbs FBS-001 --mode deterministic runs with AC-101-1 carrying expectBody.matches set in turn to ".*", "^.*$", "[\s\S]*", "(?:)", "x?" and "a|", each of which matches both canaries "qzvxjk0729" and "~!@#%^&*()" and also matches the body, then each run exits 4 and AC-101-1 has result "fail" with evidence.failedExpectation "expectBody.matches" and evidence.expected equal to the text vacuous pattern: matches both canaries "qzvxjk0729" and "~!@#%^&*()".

[failure] Given a fixture chain whose FBS-001 scopes the US-101 criteria (the test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js world), a local HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 answering GET / with status 200 and body "

Notes

Hello, world 0123abcd" and content-type "text/html", when rcf verify run --url --fbs FBS-001 --mode deterministic runs with AC-101-1 carrying expectBody.matches "(" or "[a-", a source that does not compile, then the command does not crash, it exits 4 and writes the report, and AC-101-1 has result "fail" with evidence.failedExpectation "expectBody.matches", evidence.expected "a pattern that compiles" and evidence.observed the compile error message.

[must-not] Given a fixture chain whose FBS-001 scopes the US-101 criteria (the test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js world), a local HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 answering GET / with status 200 and body "

Notes

Hello, world 0123abcd" and content-type "text/html", when rcf verify run --url --fbs FBS-001 --mode deterministic runs with AC-101-1 carrying any match-anything expectBody.matches (".*", ".+", "^", "$", ".*?", "(.*)", ".{0,}", "\S*", "[^]*" or "."), alone or beside a passing expectStatus 200, then AC-101-1 never has result "pass", runStats.counts.verified never counts it, the verdict is never "PASS" and the command exits 4.

[edge] Given a fixture chain whose FBS-001 scopes the US-101 criteria (the test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js world), a local HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 answering GET / with status 200 and body "

Notes

Hello, world 0123abcd" and content-type "text/html", when rcf verify run --url --fbs FBS-001 --mode deterministic runs with AC-101-1 carrying expectBody.matches "\w+" (which matches the word canary only) or a plain-text pattern "Notes", each matching the body, then AC-101-1 has result "pass" and the run exits 0 (a pattern matching one canary or neither is not vacuous); and with AC-101-1 carrying expectHeader { "name": "content-type", "match": ".*" } against a content-type that does not contain the literal text ".*", AC-101-1 has result "fail" with failedExpectation "expectHeader content-type" and the run exits 4 (expectHeader.match stays a substring check, untouched by the canary rule).

title: A chain author and verifier on rcf-schemas 0.9.0: assertion-required probes, retired criteria in coverage and verify, and a canary-checked expectBody.matches
